content: No, that is not correct. In Switzerland, postal voting requires you to follow specific procedures, which include signing the voting certificate. The voting certificate is a crucial part of the voting process; it confirms that you are the person entitled to vote and that you have filled out the ballot papers correctly and independently. If you do not sign the voting certificate, your vote will not be counted. Therefore, it is mandatory to sign the voting certificate before returning the completed ballot papers in the return envelope.
